infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Squadly uses your camera for KYC National ID verification, Live Liveness Selfie, and QR Attendance Check-In.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Squadly uses your microphone to record up to 60-second voice notes in activity group chats.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Squadly uses your GPS location to discover nearby activities and dispatch live coordinates during SOS emergencies.
